This vignette demonstrates an end-to-end analysis using **PharmaStatsR**. We load the example dataset, perform preprocessing, screen covariates, fit a model, generate diagnostics, and finally create a report.

## Load and validate data

```{r}
library(PharmaStatsR)
set.seed(123)

# load packaged example data
data(pharmo_example)

# ensure required columns and types
validate_data_schema(pharmo_example)
```

## Impute, center and scale

```{r}
# for illustration, introduce some missing values
pharmo_example$WT[1] <- NA
pharmo_example$AGE[2] <- NA

# Use only covariates as imputation targets and predictors.
covariates <- c("WT", "AGE", "CRCL")
imputed <- impute_ml(
  pharmo_example, c("WT", "AGE"),
  k = 5, predictors = covariates
)
cs <- center_scale(imputed, c("WT", "AGE"))
```

## Covariate screening

Hold out entire subjects when selecting the LASSO penalty. The preprocessing
above is illustrative and uses the full dataset; an evaluation workflow should
fit preprocessing separately within each training fold.

```{r}
# compare screening outputs
selected_lasso <- screen_covariates_lasso(
  cs$data,
  response = "DV",
  covariates = c("WT", "AGE", "CRCL"),
  id = "SubjectID",
  nfolds = 5
)
selected_bayes <- screen_covariates_bayesian(
  cs$data,
  response = "DV",
  covariates = c("WT", "AGE", "CRCL"),
  min_bf = 3
)

list(lasso = selected_lasso, bayesian = selected_bayes)
```

## Fit mixed-effects model

```{r}
selected <- unique(c(selected_lasso, selected_bayes))
model <- fit_covariate_model(
  cs$data,
  response = "DV",
  id = "SubjectID",
  covariates = selected
)
summary(model)
```

## Diagnostics

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4, fig.alt="Observed responses against fitted values."}
plot_obs_vs_pred(model, cs$data)
```

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4, fig.alt="Raw and normalized residuals over time."}
plot_residuals(model)
```

## Interactive diagnostics (Shiny)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
run_diagnostics_app(model, cs$data)
```

## Generate report

```{r, eval=FALSE}
if (requireNamespace("rmarkdown", quietly = TRUE)) {
  generate_report(model, cs$data)
}
```
